comment: Reusable language presets for the planning tools (brief, prompt, variants, direction, style guide). Descriptive style language only: no named living artists, no proprietary studios.

ultra-wide.text: ultra-wide 16mm lens, pronounced perspective, deep foreground

portrait.text: 85mm portrait lens, gentle compression, subject isolated

telephoto.text: 135mm telephoto, compressed layers, shallow plane of focus

macro.text: 100mm macro lens, 1:1 magnification, razor-thin depth of field

aerial.text: drone perspective, top-down and oblique, wide dynamic range

camera_heights.eye-level: camera at subject eye level, natural horizon
camera_heights.low-angle: camera low, hero angle, subject towers over viewer
camera_heights.high-angle: camera high, looking down, subject compressed and grounded
camera_heights.overhead: plan view directly overhead, flat geometric read
camera_heights.ground-level: camera at ground level, foreground texture dominant

natural-daylight.text: soft natural daylight, open sky as key, gentle falloff

golden-hour.text: low golden-hour sun, warm rim light, long soft shadows

overcast.text: flat overcast sky, even diffuse light, no hard shadows

studio-soft.text: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle fill card, controlled falloff

studio-high-key.text: high-key seamless white, twin softboxes, minimal shadow

studio-low-key.text: low-key black sweep, single hard key, deep shadow, specular accents

dramatic-side.text: hard side light, chiaroscuro split, deep shadow terminator

backlit-rim.text: backlit subject, luminous rim, atmospheric haze, lens bloom

neon-night.text: mixed neon practicals, saturated colour spill, wet reflections

clinical-flat.text: even shadowless light for technical clarity

media.photographic: photographic rendering, accurate materials, believable optics
media.editorial-illustration: flat editorial illustration, limited palette, confident shapes, subtle grain
media.watercolour: watercolour wash, visible paper tooth, soft blooms, uneven pigment edges
media.gouache: opaque gouache, matte layers, graphic edges, visible brush structure
media.ink-line: confident ink linework, variable stroke weight, sparse hatching, high contrast
media.charcoal: charcoal on textured paper, smudged tonal masses, lifted highlights
media.concept-art: production concept art, painterly blocked values, atmospheric depth, design-readable silhouette
media.storybook: storybook illustration, gentle rounded shapes, warm light, readable at small size
media.risograph: risograph print, two-ink overprint, visible dot texture, slight misregistration
media.woodcut: woodcut print, carved gouge texture, bold reduction, hard edges
media.halftone: halftone screen, dot-modulated tones, print-native texture
media.3d-render: physically based 3D render, accurate microsurface, soft global illumination
media.technical-vector: technical vector diagram, uniform strokes, labelled callouts, no textural noise
media.collage: paper collage, torn edges, layered shadows, mixed print clippings
media.pixel-art: pixel art, restricted palette, hard pixel edges, deliberate dithering
media.line-art: clean uniform outline art, no fill, closed shapes, colouring-book ready

eras.contemporary: present-day visual language, clean modern detailing
eras.mid-century: mid-century modern, 1950s-60s geometry, muted saturated palette
eras.victorian: Victorian era detailing, ornate engraving density, sepia tonality
eras.art-deco: art deco geometry, symmetrical fans, gold and deep green
eras.1980s: 1980s commercial styling, chrome, gradient washes, airbrush gloss
eras.near-future: near-future design, restrained technological integration, matte composites
eras.far-future: far-future speculature, unfamiliar but coherent materials and scale
eras.pre-industrial: pre-industrial craft materials, hand-made imperfection, natural dyes

composition_devices.rule-of-thirds: focal subject on the upper-left third intersection, horizon on the lower third
composition_devices.centred: symmetrical centred composition, subject locked to optical centre
composition_devices.golden-ratio: subject mass aligned to golden-ratio spiral, layered depth
composition_devices.diagonal: strong diagonal energy from lower-left to upper-right
composition_devices.negative-space: large deliberate negative space on the right for headline placement
composition_devices.layered-depth: clear foreground, midground and background separation with atmospheric falloff
composition_devices.flat-lay: planar arrangement, even spacing, graphic shadows
composition_devices.leading-lines: environmental lines converge on the subject
composition_devices.isolation: subject isolated on plain studio field with generous margin

negatives.general: no warped or duplicate text, no extra fingers or limbs, no melted geometry, no watermark, no signature, no unintended logos, no jpeg artefacts in flat areas, no clipped highlights
negatives.portrait: no asymmetrical eyes, no teeth artefacts, no unnatural neck-to-shoulder transition, no plastic skin
negatives.product: no wrong label spelling, no impossible reflections, no floating contact shadow, no wrong material response
negatives.architecture: no converging verticals unless intended, no impossible cantilevers, no repeated windows with identical reflection
negatives.diagram: no illegible labels, no overlapping callouts, no inconsistent arrowheads, no decorative noise
negatives.character: no inconsistent costume details across views, no changing proportion system, no inconsistent accessory placement

purposes.awareness: campaign awareness asset: emotional hit first, brand second
purposes.conversion: commerce asset: product clarity, benefit legibility, trust cues
purposes.editorial: editorial asset: point of view, restrained styling, publication fit
purposes.education: instructional asset: accuracy, legibility, annotation clarity
purposes.documentation: documentation asset: completeness and reproducibility over polish
purposes.identity: identity asset: scalability, distinctiveness, systematic reuse
purposes.entertainment: entertainment asset: narrative hook, character appeal, mood
purposes.technical: technical asset: measurement fidelity and unambiguous labelling

accessibility.note: Do not encode meaning in colour alone; pair with shape, label or pattern.
